entries.prompt: Use case: compositing. Edit the FIRST input into one finished transparent full-body 2D combat sprite. The first image is the exact existing character costume16 and stance to preserve. The second is the exact AK-74 rifle to insert: fixed reddish wooden buttstock, matching reddish wooden handguard, curved orange-brown magazine, black steel barrel, standard iron sights, NO optic. Paint this rifle into the character's existing hands at upper-chest height, barrel pointing RIGHT, stock firmly contacting the near shoulder. The near right hand wraps the pistol grip just behind the magazine, index finger at trigger guard; far left hand supports wooden fore-end from below. Permit small natural whole-arm pose correction to obtain realistic stock and hand contacts, but preserve the character, costume, green digital camouflage, helmet/goggles, balaclava, fingerless gloves, armor/pouches, holster, knee pads, boots, full-body spread leg stance, facing RIGHT. Keep the entire weapon anatomically normal and proportionate (not an oversized rifle), barrel comfortably inside frame. Draw a single coherent character holding the actual reference rifle, no disconnected spare body parts. Preserve original costume identity and colors. Blank insignia patches, no new logos, no muzzle flash. Output PORTRAIT 1024x1536, true transparent RGBA background, no backdrop, no cast shadow, no floor, no checkerboard painted into pixels. Whole head and both complete boot soles visible with margins.

review.costumeIdentity: pass: green digital camouflage, helmet/goggles, face cover, fingerless gloves, pouches, holster, knee pads and boots preserved
review.weaponIdentity: pass: fixed wood AK-74 with wood fore-end, orange curved magazine, iron sights; no optic
review.primaryGrip: pass: gloved fingers wrap pistol grip behind magazine, index finger at trigger guard
review.supportGrip: pass: fingerless support glove cups wooden fore-end
review.stockContact: pass: wood buttstock seats against near shoulder
review.fullBody: pass: helmet, muzzle and both boots complete
